title: The Price That Communicated the Wrong Thing
short_teaser: Price does more than cover cost. It can signal quality, risk, commitment, access, or confusion.
story: Price does more than cover cost. It can signal quality, risk, commitment, access, or confusion. A price that is too low may create doubt just as easily as a price that is too high creates resistance. Pricing is part of the story the offer tells. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Pricing is part of the story the offer tells. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story.
spark_application: Apply the lesson to one customer, offer, process, or decision. Ask what would make the experience clearer, more useful, or more trustworthy. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
